paper_title: New Limit on Axion-Like Dark Matter using Cold Neutrons
notes:
Extracted from Figure 4 of arXiv:2204.01454 by visual inspection of the plotted curve.
The curve shown is the solid black line representing the deterministic dark matter model.
The paper states the best limit of CG/fa × ma = 2.7×10^13 GeV^-2 (95% C.L.) is reached
in the frequency range 5 mHz to 5 Hz, corresponding to masses 2×10^-17 to 2×10^-14 eV.

Coupling type: The paper measures an oscillating neutron EDM signal induced by ALP-gluon coupling.
This is mapped to AxionEDM type (g_d in GeV^-2) as the canonical form for oscillating EDM measurements.

Data source: Figure vision - coordinates extracted from visual inspection of Figure 4 (page 4-5).
The x-axis (mass in eV) and y-axis (C_G/f_a in GeV^-1) are log scales spanning 10^-24 to 10^-3.

Dark matter density: For the deterministic case (which produces the main solid line curve shown),
ρ_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 is assumed. The paper also considers a stochastic case (dotted line)
which would require a different density model.

Confidence level: 95% as stated in the paper.

Note: There is calibration uncertainty in mapping the figure's pixel coordinates to
absolute coupling values, with estimated systematic uncertainty of a factor of 2-3.
The extraction_confidence of 0.6 reflects this calibration uncertainty.
